headline: IMF Warns Uzbekistan Against Raising Expenditure on Gold Revenues
summary: The International Monetary Fund recommended that Uzbekistan calculate its fiscal budget balance excluding gold revenues, warning that surging commodity windfalls should be directed into savings rather than expanding state spending.
why: Uzbekistan is one of the world's leading gold-producing nations, with precious metal exports contributing a major share of government tax revenues and foreign reserves.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Adopting non-gold fiscal deficit targets aims to prevent pro-cyclical fiscal spending and enhance macroeconomic stability.
